training.precision: AMP when supported; verify numerical stability
training.batch_policy: Start with a fitting micro-batch and profile peak memory/throughput; increase with headroom. Use accumulation for the chosen effective batch. Avoid simultaneous GPU jobs when comparing throughput.
training.comparison_policy: Keep original-drive splits and evaluation protocol fixed. Report matched-compute and best-achievable-quality experiments separately.

deployment_comparison.selection_policy: Do not reject a model solely by its scale. Select using measured peak system memory, original-drive perception metrics and full exposure-to-command latency on the actual hardware. Detection-only timing is insufficient.
further_export_candidates: TensorRT INT8 with representative calibration and separate accuracy validation

optional_teacher_student.condition: Consider only after direct deployment measurements. A trained x checkpoint cannot be renamed or directly loaded as an n/s checkpoint. Distillation requires separate student training and held-out evaluation; retained accuracy is not guaranteed.
